# Vision smoke-test fixture

`coffee-cup.jpg`: **Coffeecup.jpg**, Sprinno, 22 February 2012,
[Wikimedia Commons source and CC0 license](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Coffeecup.jpg).
Original: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/63/Coffeecup.jpg

Public test fixture only. This is not a resident photo, training set, or accuracy
benchmark. It is used to check that the actual browser inference path can detect
an everyday object. No images are uploaded to Supabase by these tests.

`water-bottle.jpg`: **Water Bottle (51308317077).jpg**, Alabama Extension /
Devontae Lindsey, 13 July 2021, CC0.
[Source and license](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Water_Bottle_(51308317077).jpg).
Original: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/c/ce/Water_Bottle_%2851308317077%29.jpg

`water-bottle-pack.jpg`: **Short water bottles.jpg**, Jiafei Slay Queen,
9 December 2025, CC0.
[Source and license](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Short_water_bottles.jpg).
Original: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/35/Short_water_bottles.jpg

Additional local smoke-test inputs (not training data):

- `public/images/overflow-bin-hamburg.jpg`: public-domain reference; see
  `public/images/ATTRIBUTION.md`.
- `.data/model-export/coco-397133.jpg`: COCO validation photo 397133, downloaded
  from https://s3.amazonaws.com/images.cocodataset.org/val2017/000000397133.jpg;
  development evaluation only, not redistributed with the app.
- `.data/model-export/bus.jpg`: official Ultralytics example from
  https://ultralytics.com/images/bus.jpg; development evaluation only, not
  redistributed with the app.
- `output/vision-image-tests/empty-control.png`: uniform gray synthetic control
  generated by the test script; it contains no real objects or model outputs.
